about: B1 Kaisa in Dyrfjell, B2 Gna Faste enchanter, B4 Gotar night dark hounds, B5 ice marker

entries.why: Solving the Argument (SI, giver Skorri in Dyrfjell) sent players to Kaisa the Savage trainer in West Svealand; walkthrough 721: 'Kaisa ... in the small hut near Tjasse Vindrson in Dyrfjell' (she hears Ailsa and Olvaerr arguing from there). New peaceful Midgard Kaisa beside Tjasse Vindrson (region 151, ground Z from the navmesh); the mainland Savage trainer Kaisa is left alone
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 721 'Solving the Argument' (Step #1, Kaisa's lines); CapnBry Tjasse Vindrson zone 151 32465,12097

entries.why: Solving the Argument (SI, giver Skorri in Dyrfjell) sent players to Kaisa the Savage trainer in West Svealand; walkthrough 721: 'Kaisa ... in the small hut near Tjasse Vindrson in Dyrfjell' (she hears Ailsa and Olvaerr arguing from there). New peaceful Midgard Kaisa beside Tjasse Vindrson (region 151, ground Z from the navmesh); the mainland Savage trainer Kaisa is left alone; AllowedClasses: the classes with a documented reward get their own row (P08-D2), this row keeps the classes the period reward list does not name

Protecting Myrkwood steps 1/3/5 'the enchanter in the Gna Faste guard tower' targeted Bjame, an aggressive realm-0 monster in Muspelheim. Walkthrough 521: the enchanter is a she in the Gna Faste guard tower; Bjame is the one who 'will spawn' after Haeng dies. Our Gna Faste tower (with Atzar, CapnBry zone 105 35366,39703) has Halldis, a female Enchanter (DOL.GS.Enchanter forwards ReceiveItem to its DataQuests)

Three NightSpawn copies of the Myrkwood dark hound (same template, level and aggro), ground Z from the navmesh
